description: This file manages lifecycle operations for a gateway daemon, including start, stop, restart, and uninstall, with health checks and process management.

methods.name: formatRestartFailure
methods.description: Formats failure messages based on the health snapshot, port, and timeout.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLifecyclePort
methods.description: Resolves the gateway port by reading command environment and config, with fallback.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPortFallback
methods.description: Provides fallback to resolve gateway port from config and environment.

methods.name: assertUnmanagedGatewayRestartEnabled
methods.description: Checks if unmanaged gateway restart is enabled by probing the gateway.

methods.name: resolveVerifiedGatewayListenerPids
methods.description: Finds verified gateway listener PIDs on a given port.

methods.name: stopGatewayWithoutServiceManager
methods.description: Stops unmanaged gateway processes on a port by sending SIGTERM.

methods.name: restartGatewayWithoutServiceManager
methods.description: Restarts unmanaged gateway process on a port by sending SIGUSR1.

methods.name: runDaemonStop
methods.description: Stops the gateway service, with fallback for unmanaged processes.

methods.name: runDaemonRestart
methods.description: Restarts the gateway service with health checks and retries, returns success status.
